svg.aria-label: The Neura1 graph schema: products, supply and stores; demand; people and organisation; knowledge; and work, with the relationships between them.

g.text: One company, one graph: records, knowledge and work, linked.
Chunk —MENTIONS→ any record, —SAID_BY→ Person; vector + full-text indexed. Decision —ABOUT / INSTEAD_OF→ Item, —APPLIES_TO→ Revision.
PurchaseOrder —ORDERS→ Item · Person —OWNS→ Item, Build, Customer · —LEADS→ Project · —BACKS_UP→ Person · Event —ON→ any record.
